So near that we might almost have espied
The soul’s small motions from their mutual heat,

And hardly speak at all by any sign.

author: sara_teasdale
text:
When I am all in love with you,
I say to myself that this is bliss;
And when I think of parting from you,

My heart sinks within me like a stone.

So if you really must break my heart,
Just let it be done while there’s no one else
Who knows or cares but us two alone.

But since you cannot come to me at night,
Nor yet by day, and tell me why you go,
All that remains for me to do is wait!

We see them with our eyes, though few believe
They do exist at all, I suppose!

A Land of My Own

It is a land I do not know,
I have never trod it;
My feet have been in other lands,
And my heart’s desire hath grown old
To find it there no more.

Oh! if one little corner,
One acre but of land,
Whereon to build my hut alone
In peace from all the world around,
Were mine by right of man!

author: sara_teasdale
text:
It is not an easy thing to make a friend;
But it is difficult to lose one when you have found him.

Yet such things happen. We may be so unmindful of friends
That we forget how to keep them in our lives.
How little time we spend with those we value!

As if we feared that by being too kind or openhearted,
We might bring sorrow on ourselves and our loved ones!
And then there are moments which seem to break all ties between us,
Like some sudden fall from height, like a blow upon the head.
